text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing, and controlling threats to an organization's capital and earnings. These risks can come from various sources, including financial uncertainty, legal liabilities, and natural disasters. A key step is identifying potential risks early to understand their impact. Once risks are known, businesses can develop mitigation strategies to reduce their likelihood or effect. It is also crucial to have contingency plans in place, which provide a clear course of action if a risk occurs. Finally, continuous monitoring allows companies to track existing risks and detect new ones, ensuring the risk management plan remains effective and up-to-date.
